parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description:
The name of the instance. The name must meet the following rules:

*   The name of the instance must be unique in the region where the instance is deployed.
*   The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ons ons-instance-create --remark '备注说明' --instance-name '测试实例' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ons OnsInstanceCreate --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceName '测试实例' --Remark '备注说明'
